title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta36

## Production cleanup

This beta removes development-only protocol research surfaces that were useful during earlier compatibility work but are no longer appropriate in the shipped integration.

- Remove the `navimower.probe_private_api` development action and its private endpoint-probe implementation.
- Remove the `navimower.export_raw_data` action and unredacted raw-export implementation.
- Remove exact raw MQTT payload retention and its raw-capture runtime extension.
- Remove the temporary **Passive protocol discovery** option and wildcard discovery subscription path.
- Keep legacy stored diagnostics/discovery options migration-only: upgraded entries silently discard the retired keys instead of exposing them again.
- Remove stale service, translation and documentation references to those development surfaces.

## Diagnostics and privacy boundary

- Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** is now the single shipped support-export path.
- Download diagnostics remains cached-only and sanitized; creating a report does not send mower commands or trigger additional vendor requests.
- Keep a bounded, schema-only MQTT inventory for messages already delivered by the normal current-device connection. Device identifiers are masked and exact payload bodies are not retained for this purpose.
- Remove the obsolete `mqtt_discovery` diagnostics projection left behind after Passive discovery was retired.
- Keep Google Map Tiles credentials and provider session tokens backend-owned; frontend metadata continues to expose only provider status and authenticated Home Assistant paths.

## Regression hardening

- Add a permanent privacy/interoperability regression that prevents raw export/probe services, passive discovery, exact MQTT capture and frontend secret exposure from returning accidentally.
- Convert older beta tests for Passive discovery/raw export into historical contracts so old release notes remain verifiable without forcing retired development features to stay in production.
- Keep all current mower control, Schedule, notification, Map API, georeference, underlay, History and LiDAR capability behavior unchanged.

Private field-capture work can still be performed separately by maintainers when needed, but it is intentionally outside the public integration actions and normal support workflow.
